title: CTAB-Based Protocol for Genomic DNA Extraction from Fungal and Bacterial Samples
author: Wellington Santos Fava

steps.title: Sample preparation
steps.instruction: Add to a 2 mL tube: a loopful of fungal biomass, 490 µL CTAB buffer, 10 µL proteinase K, and 6 steel beads.

steps.title: Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tube using a bead‑beater for 3 cycles at 3400 rpm, each cycle 30 s with 30 s intervals; proceed to the next step within 5 minutes.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the homogenized mixture at 60 °C for 60 minutes; move to the next step within 10 minutes.

steps.title: Organic extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, mix briefly by vortexing, then centrifuge 15 minutes at 12,000 rpm, 4 °C.

steps.title: Contaminant precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the aqueous supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 225 µL of 5 M ammonium acetate, mix by inversion, incubate on ice for 30 minutes, then centrifuge 10 minutes at 12,000 rpm, 4 °C.

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (500 µL) to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 275 µL isopropanol, mix by inversion, centrifuge 5 minutes at 12,000 rpm, 4 °C.

steps.title: Washing pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 500 µL cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 5 minutes at 12,000 rpm, 4 °C, then remove residual ethanol completely with a pipette tip after a quick spin.

steps.title: Drying pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet at 37 °C for 10–15 minutes; do not exceed this time.

steps.title: Elution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL ultrapure water or TE buffer to the dried pellet and incubate at 37 °C for 20 minutes to resuspend DNA.

steps.title: Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Mix 3 µL of eluted DNA with 3 µL GelRed, load onto an agarose gel, run at 120 V for 50 minutes; expect an intact high‑molecular‑weight band.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity with a NanoDrop. Acceptable 260/280 ratio: 1.8–2.0; 260/230 ≥ 1.8 (ideal > 2.0). Minimum concentrations: ≥ 10 ng/µL for PCR, ≥ 20 ng/µL for qPCR.
